key_findings.finding: card1=10086 is a confirmed fraudulent entity: 429 prior transactions with a label-safe matured fraud rate of 22.51%, roughly 6x the ~3.5% base rate.
The card1+email pairing has an even higher matured fraud rate of 42.14%, and gang_score is the maximum value of 1.0, indicating an organized fraud ring.
Abusive fan-out on a single card1: 63 devices, 15 email domains, 11 addr1 values — a bot/gang pattern rather than a single legitimate consumer.
Three of four top similar cases are CONFIRMED fraud (chargebacks) on the same card1=10086, all matching this profile (ProductCD=C, mastercard/credit, gmail, $10-50).

The one washed false-positive case (CASE_003) differs from this txn: it used hotmail with a low model score (0.17), whereas this txn uses gmail (matching all 3 confirmed frauds) with p=0.81, so the false-positive contrast does NOT protect this transaction.

This txn triggers the strongest entity-history rules (card1+device 6.0x, card1+email 5.4x, card1 4.9x lift) plus ProductCD=C (3.2x); the GBDT score p=0.8144 is independently corroborated, not contradicted.
Transaction amount is small ($35.66), which lowers per-txn loss but does not offset entity-level gang risk.

gang_association.rationale: gang_score=1.0 (max), extreme fan-out (63 devices/15 emails/11 addr1) on one card1, 42% matured fraud rate on card1+email, and three confirmed-fraud chargebacks on the same card1 with a matching profile — collectively indicative of an organized fraud ring operating this card1.

report.disposition_rationale: Strong entity-level fraud history plus high fan-out and max gang_score make this a ring-linked entity. Although the amount is only $35.66, escalating to freeze card1=10086 prevents future batch fraud, which under the cost framework outweighs the $40 escalation cost given the demonstrated repeat-fraud pattern. A plain decline would only stop this one small txn while leaving the entity active.
report.summary: Transaction 3547972 ($35.66, ProductCD=C, mastercard/credit, gmail, Windows desktop) runs on card1=10086, a confirmed fraudulent entity: 429 priors with a 22.5% matured fraud rate, 42% on card1+email, maximum gang_score (1.0), and heavy fan-out (63 devices/15 emails/11 addresses). Three of four similar historical cases on this same card1 are confirmed chargeback frauds with a matching profile; the one washed false positive differs meaningfully (hotmail, low model score) and does not exonerate this txn. The GBDT score of 0.81 is independently corroborated by entity evidence. Risk is high and the entity shows organized-ring behavior, so despite the small amount the recommendation is to escalate/build a case to freeze card1=10086 and block ongoing batch fraud.
